[[General/Legends|General]] '''Lesilk''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as a [[Sector commander/Legends|Sector Commander]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Known as "Lockjaw Lesilk" due to his tendency to not smile, he approved [[Hesoc]]'s request to return to flight status following the loss of the latter's right leg&mdash;and its subsequent replacement with a [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic replacement]].
